notes: Adds the People & Access foundation. Safety access is separate from role and responsibilities, Admin/Manager can switch to a simple day-to-day User view without changing real permissions, username-only accounts are supported with one-time temporary passwords and forced password change, email users keep email recovery, and Admin can reset username-only passwords without ever retrieving the old password. Adds Home Site/additional-site access ready for multi-site use and optional app capabilities while retaining existing Department, Position, H&S Manager, Department Manager, PPE and First Aid responsibility controls. Includes v2.11.36 Eye Wash default buttons. Database migrations and the manage-user-access-v21137 Edge Function are already applied to the live Safety Supabase project.
